feeds.title: The Indiana History Blog » World War II
feeds.description: The following section of The Indiana History Blog features articles on World War II. The Indiana Historical Bureau's 'Indiana History Blog' informs readers about diverse history topics and the unique sources we use to research and write about them, such as correspondence, diaries, newspapers, patents, and maps. Here we share the anecdotes, little-known stories, and historical images we come across in our research.

feeds.title: Sarah Sundin » World War II
feeds.description: Sarah shares and writes about the crisis during WWII, the shortage of things, and how people managed, she also honors war-affected places in her articles, and shares articles on books to read from the time of war. Sarah is a bestselling & award-winning author of World War II novels.

feeds.title: The History Reader » World War II
feeds.description: Follow and read articles & news on WWII only on The History Reader. For more than sixty years, St. Martin's Press has published award-winning history books on a range of subjects. Drawing on this impressive stable of experts from ancient, medieval, modern, contemporary, and military history, The History Reader offers articles, interviews, insights, and further reading for history buffs and book lovers everywhere.

feeds.title: Destination WWII Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Ashley, a full-time travel writer based in Boston, MA. I've traveled to 30 countries on 4 continents and I formed Destination: WWII with a desire to encourage and help travelers visit WWII sites around the world. On Destination WWII BLOG you'll find all of my posts, arranged in chronological order from newest to oldest. Happy reading! As always, if there is something you'd like to see here, get in touch!

feeds.title: The British Newspaper Archive Blog » World War II
feeds.description: Read articles on World War II in this segment of The British Newspaper. The British Newspaper Archive is a partnership between the British Library and Findmypast to digitize the British Library's vast collection of newspapers. We are scanning millions of pages of historical newspapers and making them available online for the first time ever.

feeds.title: D-Day Normandy and Beyond Blog
feeds.description: Blog with articles about WW2 and the Holocaust, exhibitions, interesting D-Day books, personal views, and interesting posts on museums and memorials. This website is based on eyewitness accounts of the Allied troops and Axis troops of WW2 who fought on the beaches of Normandy during D-Day and in the Battle of Normandy.

feeds.title: The Library of Congress Blog » World War II
feeds.description: The Library of Congress Blog brings you all the exclusive articles on World War II in this segment. The Library of Congress is the largest library in the world, with millions of books, recordings, photographs, newspapers, maps, and manuscripts in its collections. The Library preserves and provides access to a rich, diverse and enduring source of knowledge to inform, inspire and engage you in your intellectual and creative endeavors.

feeds.title: National WASP WWII Museum News
feeds.description: The National WASP WWII Museum is dedicated to honoring the life and legacy of the Women Airforce Service Pilots and preserving the legacy of Avenger Field on which most of them trained. Our mission is to educate and inspire all current and future generations with the story of the WASP - the first women to fly America's military aircraft - women who brought honor to our nation and forever changed the role of women in military and civilian aviation. Stay up to date with the latest news and updates on the museum, events and more!

feeds.title: wwiiafterwwii
feeds.description: There are obviously many websites on WWII weapons, and many on post-war weapons, but I have always been fascinated with WWII weapons being used after the war. This blog is a collection of information on WW2 equipment that are used after the war, photographs, history and more!

feeds.title: Warfare History Network » WWII
feeds.description: Warfare History Network, home of the foremost WWII History and WWII Quarterly magazines, is your best source for military history online. Here you'll find our in-depth and vivid accounts of the greatest war in history, from Pearl Harbor to the Battle of the Bulge; from the desperate fighting on the Eastern Front to Iwo Jima and the Battle of Midway. Our vast collection of rare photographs, battle maps, illustrations and meticulously researched articles will give you new insight into the battles, leaders, weapons, and much more.

feeds.title: World War II in Color
feeds.description: Discover more about World War II, WW2, Color, Farbe, Berwarna, ORI, Original, Germany, Italy, Japan, USA, Nazi, Great Britain, France, Soviet Union, Red Army, Waffen-SS, Luftwaffe, Kriegsmarine, Soldiers, Generals, Officers, Tank, Panzer, Tiger, Panther, Sherman, Aircraft, Bomber, Messerschmitt, Spitfire, Hitler, Churchill, Stalin, Rommel, Himmler, Goering, Roosevelt, Patton, Guderian, Mustang, Zero, Admiral, Sailot, Battleship, Holocaust, Third Reich, fascist, Kaigun, Rikugun, RAF, Battle, Operation and more!

feeds.title: Thuppahi's Blog » World War II
feeds.description: MICHAEL ROBERTS was trained in history and the social sciences at Peradeniya University in Sri Lanka. This education was in the British empiricist tradition. While Roberts can be described as a historical anthropologist, the fact remains that all his work engages the political relations of power and that he straddles the disciplines of Politics, Sociology, Anthropology and History. Check out his articles on world war 2, history articles, anecdotes, book reviews on WW2 and more!

feeds.title: World War II Database
feeds.description: My name is C. Peter Chen, I am the founder and editor of World War II Database. When this project started, it was no more than my personal notebook in which I kept notes and copies of photographs about WW2. With a relational database model, I was able to connect people, events, photographs, and other elements of history with ease, and the content of this database quickly grew. I began building the WW2DB as a public website to achieve two goals simultaneously: To share my notes with fellow military history enthusiasts and to showcase the technical capabilities of my consulting firm.

feeds.title: War History Online » World War II
feeds.description: This section of the blog website features articles and news that have to do exclusively with the Second World War. War History Online is a popular site devoted to military history. From the stone age to the first Gulf War, we've got it covered.

feeds.title: The Text Message Blog » World War II
feeds.description: This section of our blog features articles that have to do exclusively with World War II. As employees of the National Archives and Records Administration (NARA), we are stewards of billions of pages of records that contain historical and evidentiary information created by the Federal Government. The Text Message is an opportunity for staff members and volunteers to share their knowledge and discoveries with the public. We hope you enjoy reading about our finds as much as we enjoy sharing them with you.

feeds.title: A Mighty Girl Blog » World War II
feeds.description: Covers World War II Book reviews. A Mighty Girl is the world's largest collection of books, toys, and movies for parents, teachers, and others dedicated to raising smart, confident, and courageous girls.

feeds.title: Stephen Taylor, WW2 Relic Hunter
feeds.description: I am a Relic Hunter, World War 2 Historian, and expert in the identification of WW2 relics. We visit WW2 sites to recover relics and tell the stories of the personnel based there through the relics we find, archive footage and interviews with veterans. Check out some of the finds, their history in this blog.

feeds.title: WW2 Hobbyist
feeds.description: This is a site designed to celebrate the history and sacrifice of those in WW2. The site was visioned to be a place where WW2 enthusiasts can come together to share ideas, works, or stories. Initially created by a group of individuals who were interested in sharing model builds, discussion about a number of WW2 history books, and vehicles and weapons that were used, while still honoring those who made our country what it is today.

feeds.title: Tank Archives
feeds.description: This blog is dedicated to bringing World War II-era documents to the general public, with an overall focus on armoured warfare. I am a military history writer specializing in armoured warfare in the 1930s and 1940s.

feeds.title: The Historic England Blog » Second World War
feeds.description: This section of our blog website features articles that have to do exclusively with the Second World War. Some sub-topics may include Historic photography, First world war, Post-war Architecture, Listed places, and more. Historic England is the public body that helps people care for, enjoy and celebrate England's spectacular historic environment.

feeds.title: Pieces of History Blog » World War II
feeds.description: Pieces of History brings you strange-but-true stories from World War II. Pieces of History brings you the latest 'discoveries' from the vast holdings of the Archives - more than 15 billion pages of records, miles, miles of tape and film, and a growing number of electronic records. We also bring to you information about the agency itself, from our creation in 1934 to the establishment of the most recent Presidential library.

feeds.title: The National WWII Museum » War
feeds.description: The following section of The National WWII Museum is dedicated to news and findings on War. Offering a compelling blend of sweeping narrative and poignant personal detail, The National WWII Museum features immersive exhibits, multimedia experiences, and an expansive collection of artifacts and first-person oral histories, taking visitors inside the story of the war that changed the world.

feeds.title: WWII Veterans History Project Blog
feeds.description: Follow our journey of capturing WWII veteran stories, educating the next generation, and giving the past a future - one story at a time. The WWII Veterans History Project, Inc. is a nonprofit educational organization that strives for the historic preservation of the memories of the men and women who saved our country and the world during the Second World War.
